item.title: Housing Executive announces annual rent increase for tenants
item.description: The Housing Executive has announced its annual rent increase for tenants. From 6th April, 2026, rents will increase by 4.8% – this equates to an increase of £3.94 on the average weekly rent, which is currently £82.04, excluding rates.
